# Fictional literature-replay fixture

Every document, identifier, archive authority, and outcome in this directory is invented. The
fixture exists only to test the Tier B-shaped two-stage adapter. It is not an immune-epitope dataset
and its proof files must be accepted only by the explicitly injected test verifier.

`decision/` is the only namespace visible while the decision package is built. `outcome/` is first
opened after that package has been independently sealed. The string `OUTCOME-CANARY-7X9Q` must
never appear in decision artifacts or public challenge bytes.

This project-authored fixture is licensed under `CC-BY-4.0`; retain the attribution specified in
the repository `DATA_LICENSES.md`.
